Provides a resource to create a monitor multiple writes list

> **NOTE:** For the same instance of prometheus, resource `tencentcloudMonitorTmpMultipleWrites` and resource `tencentcloud.Monitor.TmpMultipleWritesList` cannot be used simultaneously. Resource `tencentcloudMonitorTmpMultipleWrites` will been deprecated in version v1.81.166, Please use resource `tencentcloud.Monitor.TmpMultipleWritesList` instead.

## Import



monitor multiple writes list can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Monitor/tmpMultipleWritesList:TmpMultipleWritesList example prom-gzg3f1em
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
